hints.title: Ordering Property Direction
hints.text: The BST ordering property determines which branch of the current node contains the target value partition boundary.

hints.title: Subtree Retention
hints.text: If current node value is at most target, the entire left subtree and the node itself belong to the lower partition.

hints.title: Recursive Reattachment
hints.text: Recursively split the appropriate subtree. Reattach the portion that belongs to the current node and return the pair of partitioned roots.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: H: height of binary search tree
complexity.notes: Traverses a single root-to-leaf path splitting subtrees in place.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding the tree from sorted node arrays takes O(N) time and creates new allocations instead of in-place pointer rewiring.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Call stack depth matches tree height H.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Direct recursive structure splitting only the right subtree if root.val <= target or left subtree otherwise.
